boxes.label: Action {n}
boxes.reader: One object per action box. Put the words in `what`, `who` and `when`, copied as written; leave a part out if it's blank. A name in `who` is the owner the team chose: keep it as written.

slide.prompt: Pick the ideas you'll actually do. Every action needs a who and a by when.
notes: Fewer, owned actions beat a long list. Two or three is plenty.
“Who” is one person, even when a group helps.
